_comment: One name, unit and basis per result figure (guided-results 04). Read by services/figure_words.py (and, from guided-results 04 slice 2, the frontend); tests/test_figure_words.py pins every backend surface to these words. '{currency}' and '{money}' are filled from the investment report.

expected_shortfall.name: Expected shortfall
expected_shortfall.basis: Expected hours a year with load not fully served (loss-of-load expectation, LOLE)

screening_shortfall.name: Screening expected shortfall over the modelled horizon (COPT)
screening_shortfall.basis: Capacity outage probability table over the modelled hours, not per year (LOLE)

project_npv.name: Project NPV at the WACC, after tax (unlevered)
project_npv.basis: Net present value of the project's after-tax cash before financing, discounted at the WACC

project_npv_pre_tax.name: Project NPV at the WACC, before tax (unlevered)
project_npv_pre_tax.basis: Net present value of the project's cash before tax and before financing, discounted at the WACC

carrier_lcoe.name: Carrier LCOE (before financing and tax)
carrier_lcoe.basis: Annualised capital and fixed O&M, plus fuel and variable O&M, per MWh the carrier produced. Storage also counts its charging energy at the bus price. No financing or tax.

study_cost_per_mwh.name: Cost per MWh served (study)
study_cost_per_mwh.basis: The study's cost at the target divided by the energy it served. Energy shed is not counted.

system_cost_per_mwh.name: System cost per MWh delivered (before financing and tax)
system_cost_per_mwh.basis: Annualised capital and fixed O&M, plus fuel, variable O&M and storage charging energy at the bus price, over all energy the portfolio delivered. No financing or tax.
